text: So sorry to bother you this late. I'm a childminder looking after an 11 year old boy overnight. His temp is 38.8 but he feels cold to touch and he's shivering a lot, his hands and feet are freezing even with a blanket on. He's wide awake though, chatting to me and watching telly, so I don't want to overreact. Sorry, I just didn't know who else to ask.
